name: Shadra: Whirling Claws lands on the player fighting her
contract: Whirling Claws fires twelve seconds after she engages and every twenty thereafter. It deals 400 physical in a twelve yard ring and punts everyone fighting her away from her body. A driven-only session cannot see the triggered cast packet or perform the client-side knockback, so the assertion is the health the sweep removes; the punt is confirmed in game.

steps.label: Hold melee through the first sweep
The sweep costs the tank health
